<thought>The spectrum shows a clear series of peaks spaced by 1 Da with intensities decreasing roughly in a binomial fashion (100 → 17.5 → 1.65 → 0.11 → ...). This pattern is characteristic of the natural ¹³C isotopic distribution in organic molecules and is the only element whose isotopic signature is unambiguously present. No M+2 pattern indicative of Cl, Br, or S is observed at significant intensity, and other elements have isotopic abundances too low to be seen. Therefore, the only element that can be definitively identified is carbon.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
